note: Bangladesh, read on 2026-10-30 in the Citizen Charter of the Bangladesh Investment Development Authority's (BIDA, Prime Minister's Office) Registration and Incentive-Commercial wing, updated 13 August 2023, in the copy a Dhaka law firm keeps on its file server (cdn2.ogrlegal.com): bida.gov.bd itself refused every TLS handshake from here and the Department of Immigration and Passports' dip.gov.bd presented a self-signed certificate on 2026-10-30, so neither was read, and the copy is marked secondary for that reason. The commercial wing grants work permits to the foreign employees and investors of branch, liaison and representative offices: a new work permit is applied for online (bidaquickserv.org) with the passport bearing the arrival stamp and an E-type, E-1 or PI-type visa, the service contract and a board resolution, for BDT 5,000 a year per person, in 16 working days subject to the inter-ministerial committee's approval; an extension of the work permit costs the same and takes the same time (renewable). The charter doesn't say whether the permit binds the holder to the employer, how long it runs, or where it is applied for beyond the arrival stamp the application carries, so none is written; it covers the commercial wing's offices only, and the permits for industrial and other employers, the visa extension the Department of Immigration and Passports grants on a work permit, permanent residence and naturalisation weren't read. The fee is charged by the year, with no permit term stated, which the form's one fee can't hold, so no fee is written.
